svg.title: What the filing promises
svg.desc: A chalkboard diagram inside the outline of the Orange Tomato mascot head. The filing (S-1 October 26, $33.2B 9M revenue) feeds four buckets: signed minimums about $417B in leases and purchase commitments, Amazon floor at least $110B take-or-pay to 2036, SpaceXAI cap up to $120.5B deliverable and cancelable, and an excluded $125 to $150B plan for 2028-31 with open terms. Notes: no filed valuation; growth may not continue.
